meta.name: verify-keyboard-access
meta.description: Verify that every interactive control on a page can take keyboard focus and that its primary action fires from the keyboard rather than only the mouse, and say plainly that Tab order cannot be verified today. Use when a component was hand-tested with a mouse, a custom dropdown/modal/combobox was added, or an accessibility report flags an unreachable control.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 逐一敲键盘检查每个控件能否聚焦并触发其主要操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果某个组件你只用鼠标点过,想确认键盘用户也能操作它。
copy.tagline_en: Check every control takes keyboard focus and fires its primary action from the keyboard.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you hand-tested a component with a mouse and need keyboard users covered.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先列出页面上所有交互控件，逐个确认能否获得键盘焦点，再用 Enter 或空格触发它的主操作并等待预期结果出现，最后按 verified、failed、blocked、unknown 给出结论。
howto.when: 当你只用手动鼠标测过某个组件、新增了自定义下拉框或弹窗、或无障碍报告指出有控件无法触达时触发。

say.text: 检查这个页面每个控件能不能用键盘操作
say.note: 会列出控件，逐个验证焦点与主操作

say.text: 验证这个自定义下拉框能用键盘触发吗
say.note: 会按下按键并等待预期结果出现
原文说明 Tab 顺序一律报 unknown

howto.what_en: After install, Claude lists every interactive control on the page, checks each can take keyboard focus, presses Enter or Space to fire its primary action and waits for the expected result, then reports verified, failed, blocked or unknown.
howto.when_en: Use when a component was only hand-tested with a mouse, a custom dropdown, modal or combobox was added, or an accessibility report flags an unreachable control.

say_en.text: Check that every control on this page works from the keyboard
say_en.note: It lists controls and verifies focus and primary action

say_en.text: Verify this custom dropdown fires from the keyboard
say_en.note: It presses the key and waits for the consequence
Tab order is always reported as unknown
